strategy.agents: read at run time: the agent body (without frontmatter) becomes the system prompt
strategy.skills: read at run time: each --skill-dir's SKILL.md is quoted whole in the system prompt; scripts, references and evals are never sent

install: none: nothing is installed; scripts/runtime.py calls run-agent.sh from this folder when runtime.json has "harness": "api"

secrets.name: OPENROUTER_API_KEY
secrets.purpose: run the floor model's eval runs through OpenRouter, and the runtime's model calls through the API adapter when its model is openrouter/<vendor>/<model>
secrets.permission: a key used only for evals and the runtime; a credit limit on it is recommended

secrets.name: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
secrets.purpose: the runtime's model calls through the API adapter (adapters/api/) when its model is anthropic/<model>
secrets.permission: an API key with a spend limit
